NSE equity futures transaction charge from 1-3-2026, 0.0018299% (Fyers' page; Zerodha's and Upstox's print it rounded, 0.00183%). It includes the IPFT, which NSE combined with transaction charges from that date (Upstox: "From now on, IPFT charges will be combined with Transaction Charges"), so this card has no IPFT line. Read 2026-10-28; docs/taxplanning-build/sources/2026-10-28-broker-charge-pages.md.
